description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Externalize configuration and remove hardcoded sensitive values for Azure-hosted operation.
tasks.reason: The service contains hardcoded URL and sensitive defaults that reduce cloud portability and security.
tasks.requirements: Migrate non-secret configuration to Azure App Configuration and move secrets to Azure Key Vault using managed identity patterns. Addresses issues: Hardcoded URLs detected, Hardcoded sensitive data detected, Connection strings without configuration builders detected.

tasks.description: Modernize SQL connectivity for Azure SQL Database.
tasks.reason: Current SQL access and dependency profile should be modernized for Azure-hosted database connectivity.
tasks.requirements: Migrate SQL connectivity to Azure SQL Database using managed identity authentication while preserving service behavior. Addresses issues: SQL database connection detected, System.Data.SqlClient dependency detected.

tasks.description: Scan project dependencies for CVEs and remediate vulnerabilities before deployment.
tasks.reason: Security validation is required to reduce known vulnerability risk prior to cloud release.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade vulnerable dependencies to minimum patched versions and document any major-version remediation risk. Verify project build and tests after remediation.

tasks.description: Containerize and deploy ZavaAlertService to Azure Container Apps.
tasks.reason: A managed Azure runtime target is needed to complete modernization and operate the service in cloud.
tasks.requirements: Build and deploy the application to Azure Container Apps, including container image build and runtime configuration alignment.
tasks.resourceStatus: use existing resource group or create as part of deployment execution
